mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and increases equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts and reduces real interest rate pressures on equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and reduces real yields, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and reduces inflation expectations, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% within a single month signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases the discount rate for future equity cash flows and reduces valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery, which increases inflationary pressures and raises the probability of future rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is above -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 850k, indicates a weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months, coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5%, signals a dual shock of supply-side contraction and labor market weakness, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
